title: St Jude's Parishioners, Halifax - WW1
memorial_details:
description: Centre of Board: ST JUDES CHURCH/ 1914 - 1918/ ROLL OF HONOUR/ (NAMES)/ FAITHFUL UNTO DEATH

Left and Right Panels: THESE ALSO SERVED IN THE FORCES/ (NAMES)/ IN GRATEFUL MEMORY OF THEIR SERVICE TO KING AND COUNTRY THIS TABLET WAS ERECTED 1920

On reredos: TO THE GLORY OF GOD IN MEMORY OF THE FALLEN IN THANKSGIVING FOR VICTORY AND PEACE RESTORED THE ALTAR AND REREDOS WERE ERECTED BY THE PARISHIONERS IN THE YEAR OF OUR LORD NINTEEN HUNDRED AND TWENTY REQUIEM ETERNAM DONA EIS DOMINE ET LUX PERPETUA LUCET EI CUM SANCTIS TUIS IN ETERNUM
